definitions.name: G2B.NORMALIZE
definitions.body: 'G2B.XS' BIND G2B.XS G2B.XS G1A.MIN - G2B.XS G1A.RANGE /
definitions.note: rescale each number of a numeric Vector to (x - min) / (max - min)

definitions.name: G2B.CAP
definitions.body: CHARS 'G2B.C' BIND G2B.C [ 1 ] TAKE JOIN UPPER G2B.C [ 1 ] DROP JOIN ' ' 3 COLLECT JOIN
definitions.note: a word with its first letter upper-cased, followed by one trailing space

definitions.name: G2B.TITLECASE
definitions.note: title-case a space-separated String: every word's first letter upper-cased

definitions.name: G2B.ACRONYM
definitions.body: G0A.WORDS [ CHARS 0 GET UPPER ] MAP JOIN
definitions.note: upper-cased first letters of every word of a String, as one String
